issues.description: In the template for Exercise 5 (Kakuro), the attribute number_of_qubits_query_register is initialized to a float (0.0). QuantumRegister in Qiskit expects an integer number of qubits, so this will cause a type error or confusing behavior for students. The problem description and the solution both treat the query register size as an integer (the solution uses 4 qubits), so the float in the template is a structural/type inconsistency that will block students when they try to construct the QuantumRegister.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template initialization of number_of_qubits_query_register from 0.0 (float) to an integer. For example, use 0 (int) as a neutral placeholder or match the solution and set it to 4: number_of_qubits_query_register = 4. Ensure the type is int so QuantumRegister(...) can be constructed without error.
